This is first application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant in connection with Crime No.557/2023 registered at Police Station - Raipuria, district Jhabua (M.P.)
under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and section 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2.
As per prosecution story, prosecutrix eloped with the present applicant and lived for a long time as husband and wife.

3. Counsel for the applicant submits that age of the prosecutrix as per prosecution itself is 17 years Ajay Lodha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121445201/
1 and 5 months.

sentences.text: The parents of prosecutrix has filed affidavit stating that age of the prosecutrix is 18 years.
4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail and submits that age of prosecutrix is less than 18 years and therefore applicant does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.

5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the statement of prosecutrix and the fact that her age is nearing 18 years as per prosecution story itself coupled with the fact that investigation is completed and chargesheet has been filed, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that Applicant- Ajay Lodha shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the court below.
C.c. as per rules.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE MK Ajay Lodha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121445201/
